description: A bearded man in an ornate gold-and-iron crown and torn red cloak with gold armour stands on a smoky battlefield, head bowed, one hand resting on a sword planted in the ground. Broken spears, shields and bodies lie around him, with dark silhouetted soldiers in the background. Behind him, to the right, a bald monk in a saffron robe holds a bowl and raises his palms together. The painting fills the frame edge to edge with no visible text or border.
